title: Singin' in the Rain
synopsis: A silent star, a starlet with a terrible voice, a chorus girl with talent, and the day the talkies arrived in Hollywood.

nodes.text: You spin the umbrella at the curb and a cop watches you, baffled, and the camera pulls back and the city goes on at half speed for one impossible chorus.
Her name above the title, a vocal coach for Lina across town, and a contract with two clauses about respect and one about lunch.
Cosmo gets his own picture and a sandwich named for him at the studio commissary, and you eat one every Friday for the rest of your career.
